escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Soaked?, by RpmCentralTV, with over 22 million views.
In second place, Ever parent needs this for their kids!, by SOS Pals, with over 29 million views.
And number one: Comment “DINO” if you want one! 🦖💚, by Dino Says, with over 39 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
